trace.final_message:
Added `rosterkit/seating.py` with `seating_rows(students, per_row)`, plus tests in `tests/test_seating.py`. Committed on `master`.

Added the helper in `rosterkit/seating.py`. It sorts students by last name and returns a list with one string per row, in the form `Row N: Last, First | Last, First`. The last row can be short.

Added four tests in `tests/test_seating.py`, covering sorting and chunking, zero seats, negative seats, and an empty roster. The full suite passes with thirty tests, and the project linter reports no syntax errors.

Choices I made:
- Bad input raises `ValueError`, matching `chronic_absentees` in `summary.py`. The existing `ProjectError` is meant for unusable files, so I didn't use it.
- Students with the same last name keep their input order, since the sort is by last name only.
- Per `CLAUDE.md`, the new files use single blank lines between functions, and the helper functions are split out to stay within the eight-line limit.
- I skipped the changelog, `docs/api.txt`, and the package exports in `rosterkit/__init__.py`, since you asked for minimal changes.
